newsitem.title: UK: Douglas Hall has controlling stake in Newcastle FC.
newsitem.headline: Douglas Hall has controlling stake in Newcastle FC.

text.p: Douglas Hall will take a majority stake in Newcastle United Plc after his father Sir John Hall transferred control of the family's Cameron Hall Developments (CHD) to him, the club said on Monday.
A supplementary flotation prospectus showed that Douglas Hall would control 57.7 percent of the premier league soccer club's stock when it is floated next week.
The prospectus noted that Douglas Hall would hold the stake after an increase in his shareholding in CHD, the Hall family's privately owned property development company.
Millionaire property developer Sir John Hall has helped to bankroll Newcastle United's progress towards the top of English soccer in recent years.

However, Sir John will not be on the board of Newcastle United after flotation. But, he will remain as chairman of the subsidiary soccer team and plans to help the club develop an academy for young players.
